blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sugar travels around the world. Usually it goes by sea, in big ships. Ships are slow, but they are cheap. One ship can carry a lot of sugar.

Sometimes sugar goes by truck or by train inside a country. First, a truck takes the sugar from the mill to the port. Then the ship carries it across the ocean. At the end, another truck takes it to the client.

Every route has a cost. By sea is the cheapest. By plane is the fastest, but it is very expensive. So most sugar goes by sea, and only documents go by plane.

items.q: How does sugar usually travel?
items.why: "Usually it goes by sea, in big ships."

items.q: What takes the sugar from the mill to the port?
items.why: "First, a truck takes the sugar from the mill to the port."

items.q: Which route is the cheapest?
items.why: "By sea is the cheapest."

items.q: The text suggests that companies choose ships because they…
options: are cheap and carry a lot
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que navios são baratos e levam muito açúcar — por isso a escolha.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which sentence?
options: A truck goes from the mill to the port.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que avião é caro e só documentos vão por avião — logo, a maioria NÃO vai de avião.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan mostrando o caminho do açúcar no mapa. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! Look at my map. I want to show you the journey of the sugar. It is easy to follow.

First, a truck picks up the sugar at the mill. The truck drives to the port in Santos. It is not a long trip, so the truck is a good choice for this part.

Then the sugar goes on a big ship. The ship crosses the ocean. This part is slow. It takes many days, sometimes weeks. But the ship is cheap, and it carries a lot of sugar. That is why we love ships.

When the ship arrives, another truck picks up the sugar. This truck takes it to the client. In some countries, we use a train, because a train can also carry a lot.

We almost never use a plane. A plane is very fast, but it is too expensive for sugar. We only send documents by plane.

So the route is simple: truck, ship, and truck again. Sometimes a train helps too. It is slow, but it is cheap. And for sugar, cheap is the right choice. Thank you for looking at my map!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What picks up the sugar at the mill first?
items.why: "First, a truck picks up the sugar at the mill."

items.q: Which part of the journey is slow?
items.why: "Then the sugar goes on a big ship… This part is slow."

items.q: Why does the company almost never use a plane for sugar?
items.why: "A plane is very fast, but it is too expensive for sugar."

items.q: Ethan suggests that the company likes ships because…
options: they are cheap and carry a lot
items.why: Inferência: "the ship is cheap, and it carries a lot of sugar. That is why we love ships."

items.q: How does Ethan feel about the whole route?
items.why: Inferência: "the route is simple: truck, ship, and truck again… it is cheap. And cheap is good for sugar!"

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The ship leaves the port tomorrow." A ship is…
options: a big boat that carries cargo on the sea
items.why: Ship = navio: barco grande que leva carga pelo mar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ takes the sugar from the mill to the port."
items.why: Truck = caminhão: leva a carga da usina até o porto.

items.q: "Some countries move cargo by train." A train…
options: runs on rails and carries a lot
items.why: Train = trem: anda sobre trilhos e leva muita carga.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Documents can go by ___ because it is fast."
items.why: Plane = avião: é rápido, bom para documentos.

items.q: "Each route has a cost." A route is…
options: a way or path from one place to another
items.why: Route = rota: o caminho de um lugar até outro.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem quando falamos de envio e transporte. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The truck will pick up the sugar at the mill." To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar, coletar a carga.

items.q: "The truck will drop off the sugar at the port." To drop off means to…
items.why: Drop off = deixar, entregar a carga em um lugar.

items.q: "The ship will set off tomorrow morning." To set off means to…
items.why: Set off = partir, começar a viagem.

items.q: "The sugar must ship out this week." To ship out means to…
items.why: Ship out = ser enviado, sair para o cliente.

items.q: "The ship arrived on time." On time means…
options: at the right time, not late
items.why: On time = no horário, sem atraso.
